known_gaps: HTTP, MCP, and CLI projections are specified but are not implemented for the complete profile
the Rewind adapter binds verified gateway claims and atomic use, but production dispatch wiring is not enabled by this candidate
safe accretion storage is an in-memory reference and is not a durable production memory authority
cross-language facades cover portable contracts and local orientation; controlled host execution remains Python-only

independent interoperability, governance ratification, profile publication as a protocol release, deployment, and human accessibility review remain open; the Python, Rust, and TypeScript facades ship in the published SDK 4.2.0 packages

authority_boundaries.publication: profile unpublished; facades ship in SDK 4.2.0
